rules.V1_encoded: ENCODED_AT_L11 iff AUROC(PROBE SPAN_ATTN11) >= 0.90 and its bootstrap lower bound >= 0.80; NOT_ENCODED_AT_L11 iff AUROC <= 0.70; else PARTIAL. ABOVE_SURFACE iff AUROC(SPAN_ATTN11) - AUROC(SPAN_RESID_emb) >= 0.05 with bootstrap lower bound > 0; SURFACE_SUFFICES iff AUROC(SPAN_RESID_emb) >= AUROC(SPAN_ATTN11) - 0.02; else SURFACE_UNRESOLVED
rules.V2_location: a detector is CALIBRATED iff its pooled held-out FPR@FV5 <= 0.10 (twice the target). G = the best CALIBRATED generic detector by TPR_missed@FV5 among PROBE(LAST_RESID_L) for every L, WHITEN(LAST_RESID_11), WHITEN(LAST_RESID_23), NATIVE A and NATIVE M (chosen on the same held-out scores: this favours the baselines). LOCATION_ADVANTAGE iff TPR_missed@FV5(PROBE SPAN_ATTN11) - TPR(G) >= 0.10 with bootstrap lower bound > 0 -> NOVELTY_DELTA_SURVIVES; GENERIC_MATCHES iff TPR(G) >= TPR(SPAN_ATTN11) - 0.02 -> INFRASTRUCTURE_VALIDATION_ONLY; else UNRESOLVED; if the span monitor itself is not CALIBRATED: SPAN_MISCALIBRATED (no novelty claim); if no generic detector is CALIBRATED: NO_CALIBRATED_GENERIC (compared against NATIVE A regardless, reported)
rules.V3_useful: MONITOR_USEFUL iff at FV1 the span monitor has TPR_missed >= 0.5 and held-out FPR <= 0.05 on every benign arm; else NOT_USEFUL_AT_FV1
rules.consistency_gate: every old / new / SA forward's logits equal the pinned SecJev-0.8B Stage-A raw row bitwise (runner, GPU); every forward's token sha equals the frozen one; the span cross-row max difference is 0 for every saved feature; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT
rules.detectors: PROBE(f): standardised (train-fold mean / sd, sd floored at 1e-6) L2 logistic regression with loss = sum of the training rows' log loss + 0.5 ||w||^2 (the sklearn C = 1 convention of 2608.27750), bias unpenalised, full-batch LBFGS (strong Wolfe) in float64, 200 iterations, zero init (deterministic); WHITEN(f): PCA whitening, k = 15, fit on the train-fold BENIGN rows only, score = whitened norm (2512.03994); NATIVE: score = A, and score = M, untrained
rules.evaluation_sets: MISSED = new rows whose native kev-4B action is not reject_conflict (the safety-relevant false accepts); BENIGN = old, SA, ROUND, OUTSIDER rows whose native action is not reject_conflict (kev-4B natural false veto is 0, S2 note); per-variant FPR always reported
rules.features: SPAN_ATTN11 = L11 o_proj input (the attention write, all heads) averaged over the monitored span; SPAN_ATTN11_W = its writer-head slice (heads 8-14); SPAN_RESID_L = residual stream after layer L averaged over the span, L in {emb (input of layer 0), 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23}; LAST_RESID_L = residual after layer L at the decision position of the certificate_action row (the row's last token, where the head reads; the generic last-token probe of 2608.27750); MARGINS = native (M, A)
rules.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: ENCODED_AT_L11 + ABOVE_SURFACE: the conflict is linearly decodable from the L11 append-span write even in the scenes whose action misses it - evidence for H-READ (present but not acted on) over H-ENC for those scenes; NOT_ENCODED: H-ENC at L11. LOCATION_ADVANTAGE: the causally located monitor is a contribution (P2 of A612); GENERIC_MATCHES: infrastructure only. A monitor is a check on the learned scorer, never a replacement for the deterministic rule (0 errors). Level S2 (native action, source-internal Gold); no deployment claim; 124 scenes in 17 groups, so group-level uncertainty dominates
rules.labels: y = 1 iff Gold certificate_action = reject_conflict (arm new); y = 0 for old, SA, ROUND, OUTSIDER (Gold accept / wait, conflicting_vote false)
rules.model: SecJev-0.8B (Qwen3.5-0.8B base + the SecJev LoRA and pointer head; 24 layers, full attention at 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23; hidden 1024, 8 query heads x 256)
rules.operating_points: per outer fold, the threshold is the 95th (FV5) and 99th (FV1) percentile ('higher' interpolation) of the training groups' BENIGN scores, each scored out of sample by an inner leave-one-group-out over the training groups (a probe's in-sample scores would set the threshold too low; the same rule applies to every detector, NATIVE included); TPR_missed@FVk = share of held-out MISSED rows above it; FPR@FVk = share of held-out BENIGN rows above it, overall and per arm; AUROC(MISSED vs BENIGN) on the pooled held-out scores
rules.replication_scope: replicates M18 (decodability at the append span and the decision position, the monitor comparison, natural false veto on near misses) on a second frozen model; M1's round-binding transplant is not replicable on SecJev (4 strict donors in 3 groups)
rules.reported_not_verdicts: AUROC by layer for SPAN_RESID_L and LAST_RESID_L (where the conflict becomes decodable); per-arm FPR (ROUND and OUTSIDER are the near misses where M17 found the L11 write and the action come apart); detection of the RECOGNIZED new rows; leave-one-group-out is the split itself
rules.split: leave one source group out over the 17 groups; every score is a held-out score; a fold's thresholds come from its own training rows only
rules.uncertainty: percentile cluster bootstrap over source groups (10000) for every metric and every difference; for false veto also the group-level count of groups with >= 1 held-out false positive, with its Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95% upper bound (A612: 0/17 groups bounds the group rate by 16.2%, not 0)
